about.en: Domains of the vault. 'memory' domains hold conversations and Aurora's own reflections and live in separate shards (vault/memory), so that a reset of the memory never touches knowledge. A domain is a subject, never a source: where a text comes from is recorded in source_id.
about.it: Domini del vault. I domini di 'memoria' contengono le conversazioni e le riflessioni di Aurora e stanno in shard separati (vault/memory), così un reset della memoria non tocca mai la conoscenza. Un dominio è una materia, mai una fonte: da dove viene un testo è registrato in source_id.

networks and their protocols, routing, firewalls, network defence and monitoring
cryptography, attacks and vulnerabilities, malware, privacy and security of software
programming languages, software engineering, libraries, their documentation and code
information, entropy, coding and channel theory, signal compression
pure and applied mathematics: algebra, analysis, geometry, number theory, combinatorics, logic
statistical methods, inference, probability applied to data
general, classical, optical, fluid and atomic physics not in a narrower physics domain
quantum mechanics, quantum information and computing
high-energy, particle and nuclear physics
solids, superconductivity, soft matter, statistical mechanics of materials
stars, galaxies, planets, cosmology and astronomical observation
general relativity, gravitation, black holes, gravitational waves
the mathematical structures of physical theories
chaos, solitons, pattern formation, complex and dynamical systems
chemistry and chemical physics, molecules, reactions
materials science: properties and making of materials
geology, climate, atmosphere, oceans, geophysics
electrical, signal, control, audio and image engineering
robots, their control, perception and planning
cell and molecular biology, immunology, neuroscience, microbiology, pharmacology research
genomes, genetics, bioinformatics, evolutionary biology
clinical medicine, diseases, the human body, health care, treatments
mind, behaviour, cognition, mental health
economics, finance, markets, business
politics, sociology, anthropology, education, languages, communication, sport, everyday social life
past events, civilisations, wars, empires, historical figures, archaeology, mythologies as history of cultures
philosophers, schools of thought, ethics, metaphysics, epistemology, logic as philosophy
religions, their beliefs, scriptures, practices, gods and religious figures

patents and patent applications
